brain_rot_decomposition.what_it_actually_is: Brain rot content is the LOWEST EFFORT material that captures the MOST attention. It's the McDonald's of content — empty calories that humans can't stop consuming.
brain_rot_decomposition.why_it_works: Recognition > information. Viewers don't want to LEARN, they want to FEEL SEEN. 'I do that too' > 'I didn't know that'.
brain_rot_decomposition.nutrient_content: The nutrient isn't the content itself. The nutrient is the PATTERN: what captures human attention at zero cost? What is the minimum viable stimulus? Brain rot answers: recognition of shared behavior.
brain_rot_decomposition.micro_creators_beat_brands: 4 of top 5 viral gaming TikToks were from accounts with <20K followers. The algorithm rewards the CONTENT not the CREATOR. Signal > source.

the_human_at_the_screen.kevin_insight: Twitch streamers show the person playing video games staring at the screen, so you at least have a concept of what I might look like while staring at the monitor. We can use that as an overlay.

science_of_gamer_faces.accuracy: 83.8% engagement detection from facial recordings alone
key_findings: ENGAGED gamers become MORE STILL — less head movement, slower blinks
DISENGAGED gamers FIDGET more — more movement, gaze shifts, postural changes
30 facial feature points predict attention (eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw)
Head pose (yaw/pitch/roll) correlates with emotional state
Blink rate DECREASES during focus, INCREASES during boredom
Keyboard/mouse input patterns change with emotional state — faster inputs ≠ more engaged

nutrients_extracted.attention_patterns: What captures human eyes: recognition > information. Shared behavior > novel content. Minimum viable stimulus.
nutrients_extracted.engagement_biometrics: The face reveals everything. Stillness = focus. Blink rate = engagement meter. Head pose = emotional state.
nutrients_extracted.content_lifecycle: Waste → attention → engagement → memory → behavior change. Most content dies at step 1. Brain rot succeeds at step 1 by exploiting recognition.
nutrients_extracted.long_tail_devotion: 83.3K streamers, avg 34 viewers each. Most of the internet is people performing for nearly nobody. That IS the organic behavior — the organism growing in the dark.
nutrients_extracted.ancient_persistence: GTA V (13 years), WoW (22 years), Minecraft (15 years). Organisms that found the right niche PERSIST. Evolution rewards fitness, not novelty.
